facts.rationale: Replaces the incorrect setup-variant interpretation with canonical helper semantics while preserving exact numeric branches and cross-callback state movement.
facts.value: On entry, the callback copies VS data into CSSData.vs, sets all indexed unlockable-character availability bits, and, for odd match_type values, calls the character-lock helper with character kind 7. That helper clears the mapped availability bit unless mapping returns its sentinel. On departure, pending_scene_change == 2 decrements nonzero match_type or wraps zero to 23; every other pending value computes (match_type + 1) % 24. Both departure paths commit CSSData.vs back to shared VS storage. The backward branch assumes a valid selector rather than enforcing the 0–23 domain for arbitrary inputs.
